completed.meaning: True when the radio read completed without a refusal.

present.meaning: Whether NetworkManager listed a Wi-Fi device.

enabled.meaning: Global NetworkManager Wi-Fi radio state, false if not observed enabled.

device.meaning: First listed Wi-Fi device, or null if none was observed.

radios.meaning: Per-device radio posture from the NetworkManager device list.

product.meaning: NetworkManager product description, or null when missing or unreadable.

enabled.meaning: Per-device rfkill soft state when readable, otherwise the global radio state.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The stop's outcome token; none when no signal is missing.
